name: Elemental Knowledge (Mythic)
body:
Your instinctive knowledge of the elemental world grows.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Knowledge.

Benefit: You gain all the skill unlocks for the skills related to your expanded elements, as per the Signature Skill feat.
